_readme: THE MERRIMACK'S ENTRANCE BAR UNDER A DECLARED GROUNDSWELL (2026-10-23): merrimack_bar.json's clocks and
views, with the sea declared instead of read -- Hs 2.5 m, Tp 11 s, from 70 degrees (an east-northeast
groundswell, the bar's working sea) -- so the bar is judged at a size that breaks over it, not at the day's
buoys (0.3 m on 2026-10-23). sea.storm overrides the forecast grid and the buoys' assimilation alike.
Launch from the repo root:  build/bin/gagame.exe scenes/demos/merrimack_bar_swell.json
Views: bar_low (the default), entrance_east, entrance_west, entrance_above (merrimack_bar.json).
FLY: W A S D move, Q / E down / up, hold the right mouse button to look.
